__warning: PLACEHOLDER DATA. Every number in this file was lifted from the frozen design mockup at design/mockups/country.html. The mockup's own footer calls its figures illustrative. Nothing here has been researched, sourced or reconciled, every figure is tiered thin, and none of it may ever be served to a reader. It exists so the country page contract, the adapter and the components can be built and tested against the exact shape and scale of the design. Real files live in data/countries/ and must be hand-filled with provenance.

zones.verdict: Nothing here moves the needle for a high-street trade. The freeports and enterprise zones matter for warehousing and manufacturing, not a shop or a restaurant. If that changes for your trade, this section will say so.

verdict.text: In the United Kingdom, the state and the landlord are paid before the owner is. A company exists in a day for $60, and then the bank, the rates and the rent arrive. What separates the trades that pay their owner from the ones that do not is almost never the demand; it is what they signed for the room.

remember.text: Easy to start, expensive to hold. The United Kingdom asks little to let you begin and a great deal to let you stay on a good street.
